facts.fact: Orson Grey 在四天里送来了第六束花
facts.anchor: That made it the sixth bouquet in four days.

facts.fact: Orson 的情书抄的是勃朗宁《葡萄牙十四行诗》第 43 首的中段而非人人会背的开头
facts.anchor: He’d copied a portion of Browning’s Sonnets from the Portuguese, number 43.

facts.fact: 父亲的社交生活基本只有 Hoffman House 酒吧的每周文学沙龙
facts.anchor: his regular social interaction was mostly limited to a weekly literary salon in the bar of the Hoffman House.

facts.fact: Caroline 的母亲在她还是婴儿时便去世，父亲很想念母亲
facts.anchor: She had died so young, when I was just a baby, and my father missed her terribly.

facts.fact: 相识六周后 Orson 求婚，Caroline 爽快答应
facts.anchor: When he proposed six weeks after we met, I happily accepted.

facts.fact: Orson 要求六月立刻完婚，随后一起去 Bar Harbor 度夏
facts.anchor: He wanted to be married straightaway, in June, then summer in Bar Harbor together.

facts.fact: 新婚夜的火车车厢里 Orson 说妻子的身体属于他
facts.anchor: As your husband, your body belongs to me.

facts.fact: Orson 要 Caroline 在床上铺羊毛毯「为了血迹」
facts.anchor: Place that underneath you. For the blood.
